- [`scripts/query-ubermind-library.py`](../../scripts/query-ubermind-library.py) — Local bounded retrieval of exact snippets from the four private UberMind ZIP packs by query. · **Use:** search Grand Library sources locally
- [`scripts/ubermind-claude-ai-skill-pack.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-claude-ai-skill-pack.mjs) — Validates and zips the ubermind-lean skill for claude.ai upload. · **Use:** Packages the skill.
- [`scripts/ubermind-conditional-agent-doctor.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-conditional-agent-doctor.mjs) — Doctor for conditional agent optimizer (Omega16). · **Use:** Checks Omega16 optimizer.
- [`scripts/ubermind-five-percent-preflight.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-five-percent-preflight.mjs) — Offline preflight that runs source-bound E1 proof execution and measures source bytes of startup context against a five-percent compression gate, no model calls · **Use:** check whether UberMind startup context compression target is met without claiming token savings
- [`scripts/ubermind-omega42-agent-tree-console.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-omega42-agent-tree-console.mjs) — Offline operator console that runs fixed native W40/W41 tests on the checkout and reports results, refusing to bind results to HEAD when untracked changes exist · **Use:** truthful local report of UberMind agent-tree test status
- [`scripts/ubermind-public-issue-intake.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-public-issue-intake.mjs) — Read-only fetcher of 12 explicitly approved public GitHub issues as a workload, using the existing relay credential, with secret scrubbing and bounded concurrency · **Use:** capture public-issue tasks as untrusted UberMind/Jev evaluation workload
- [`scripts/ubermind-startup-context-audit.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-startup-context-audit.mjs) — Parses top-level @path imports in CLAUDE.md and reports their source byte sizes, explicitly not the tokenizer bill · **Use:** audit how much material Claude startup imports load
- [`scripts/ubermind-strategy-brief.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-strategy-brief.mjs) — CLI that compiles a strategic brief by combining Omega49 source selection, Omega51 evidence and Omega52 research pointers for a question · **Use:** produce an Opus strategy microbrief from Omega doctrine sources
- [`scripts/ubermind-v6-source-doctor.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-v6-source-doctor.mjs) — Hashes and cross-checks the V6 52-operation registry against the founder 52-directive coverage manifest to verify source custody · **Use:** verify V6 52-card registry matches founder source files
- [`scripts/ubermind-w40-route-doctor.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-w40-route-doctor.mjs) — Samples routes from the W40 evidence-first task compiler and evaluates contract files against it · **Use:** check UberMind W40 task routing contract health
- [`scripts/ubermind-w41-proof-route-doctor.mjs`](../../scripts/ubermind-w41-proof-route-doctor.mjs) — Runs an illustrative W41 proof-constrained route auction across task kinds such as existing-proven-work, novel architecture and source lookup · **Use:** inspect how W41 auction routes tasks by proof requirements
- [`scripts/verify-ubermind-archives.py`](../../scripts/verify-ubermind-archives.py) — Offline Python validator of the four UberMind grand-library ZIPs, testing integrity and hashing members · **Use:** verify grand library archives before attaching to projects
